title: Location
description: A `Location` represents a warehouse, store, or other physical place used for fulfillment, order processing, and pickup settings. Location resources are scoped to the organization and are not bound to a store.

id.description: The unique identifier of the location. For locations created through Commerce API, this is the custom ID supplied when creating the location, or a system-generated UUID if no custom ID was provided. For ecommerce platform-sourced locations, the ID is returned in the format `app-<platform>-<app_key>-<external_id>`.

source.description: The source of the location. `manual` means the location was created through Commerce API. `platform` means the location was imported from an ecommerce platform.

address.description: The physical address and contact information of the location. For Location resources, `first_name` and `last_name` are joined into one contact name on write; on read, the full contact name is returned as `first_name` and `last_name` is empty. The `type` field is accepted by the schema but not used for Location resources — omit it on write; on read it is always empty.

timezone_identifier.description: The name of the timezone where the location is located, as defined by the [IANA timezone database standard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones).

opening_hours.description: The regular opening hours of the location.

order_processing.description: The order processing setting for this location.

enabled.description: Whether order processing is enabled for this location.

order_cutoff_time.description: The daily cutoff time for processing orders in `HH:mm` format.

order_processing_duration_days.description: The number of business days needed to process an order. Use `0` when fulfillment can be completed within 1 business day.

pickup_setting.description: The pickup setting for this location.

enabled.description: Whether pickup is enabled for this location.

instructions.description: Pickup instructions shown to the customer.

order_processing_duration_seconds_min.description: The minimum number of seconds needed before the order is ready for pickup.

order_processing_duration_seconds_max.description: The maximum number of seconds needed before the order is ready for pickup.

created_at.description: The date and time when the location was created in AfterShip, formatted in ISO 8601.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the location was updated in AfterShip, formatted in ISO 8601.

Address_with_coordinate.v1.description: The physical address and contact information of the location. For Location resources, `first_name` and `last_name` are joined into one contact name on write; on read, the full contact name is returned as `first_name` and `last_name` is empty. The `type` field is accepted by the schema but not used for Location resources — omit it on write; on read it is always empty.

street_3.description: Third line of the street address.

state.description: The state or region of the location, such as a province, state, or prefecture.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the location (also known as zip code, postcode, Eircode, etc.).

first_name.description: The first name of the person associated to the address.

last_name.description: The last name of the person associated to the address.

email.description: The email address of the person associated to the address.

phone.description: The phone number of the person associated to the address.

Opening_hour_period.v1.title: OpeningHourPeriod
Opening_hour_period.v1.description: The `OpeningHourPeriod` model provides detailed information about a location's operating hours for a specific day. It includes the start and end times, and indicates whether the location is open on that particular day.

open.description: Indicate whether the store is open on this day. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `true`.

from.description: The start time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

to.description: The end time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

Opening_hours.v1.description: The regular opening hours of the location.
Opening_hours.v1.title: OpeningHours
